image_description: A close-up shot of two spoonbills interacting. The primary subject on the left is a Roseate Spoonbill, characterized by pink plumage on the wings and body, white neck, and a distinctive long, flat, spatulate bill with a greyish base and pale tip. It has a visible orange eye and greenish facial skin. A second spoonbill (likely a Eurasian or Royal Spoonbill) is visible on the right, showing a yellowish-orange bill and white plumage. They appear to be perched on branches with a blurred green foliage background.
